verdict.rationale: Insomnia explicitly documents external vault integration for retrieving secrets at request time (insomnia-docs-24) and environment variables for tokens/credentials (insomnia-docs-33), supporting keeping secrets out of shared files. However, there's no explicit documentation of a 'masked secret' UI feature (e.g., hidden/obscured values in the app), and all evidence is vendor docs with no independent corroboration. Missing for 10: explicit masked-secret display feature, third-party/hands-on confirmation of vault integration working in practice.
